test_cases.name: testAverageOfWeek
test_cases.message: average() should return 7500.0 for the steps [6000, 8000, 7000, 9000].

test_cases.name: testAverageOfSingleDay
test_cases.message: The average of a single day should be the step count of that day.

test_cases.name: testDaysReachingGoal
test_cases.message: With a goal of 10000, three of the days [12000, 4000, 11000, 9999, 15000] reach the goal.

test_cases.name: testDayExactlyAtGoalCounts
test_cases.message: A day with exactly 10000 steps should count as reaching a goal of 10000.

test_cases.name: testNoDayReachesGoal
test_cases.message: No day of [1000, 2000, 3000] reaches a goal of 5000, so the result should be 0.

test_cases.name: testLongestStreak
test_cases.message: The longest streak of days reaching 10000 steps in [11000, 12000, 3000, 10500, 10200, 10100, 2000] is 3 days long.

test_cases.name: testLongestStreakWithoutAnyGoalDay
test_cases.message: If no day reaches the goal, the longest streak should be 0.

test_cases.name: testLongestStreakAtEnd
test_cases.message: A streak at the end of the array should be counted: [1000, 11000, 12000] has a streak of 2 days.
